import sys

def main():
    for token in sys.stdin.read().split():
        n = len(token)
        used_at = False
        out = []
        pos = 0
        while pos < n:
            if pos > 0 and pos <= n - 3 and token[pos:pos+3] == "dot":
                out.append('.')
                pos += 3
            elif pos > 0 and pos <= n - 2 and token[pos:pos+2] == "at" and not used_at:
                out.append('@')
                used_at = True
                pos += 2
            else:
                out.append(token[pos])
                pos += 1
        print(''.join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
